scope: new selected_risk_accounting.py, collect_selected_risk_costs.py, selected_risk_budget allowance delta and corresponding accounting/budget fixtures only

issues.finding: Refreshing from current registrations can drop previously charged local receipt rows/file pins; only own fee-collection receipts auto-return. Versioned old snapshots survive but the canonical ledger consumed by budgets loses prior failure/review/admin costs.
issues.fix: Preserve or independently enforce monotonic prior receipt/file-pin history; reject omitted/changed prior charges absent an explicit audited correction protocol.

issues.finding: Filename prefix eligibility does not confine fee provenance. Explicit registration can point to a closed oldA62/POST root_/review_ file and charge it again on top of the fixed predecessor baseline while reporting baseline_not_recharged=True.
issues.fix: Constrain to exact new A63 receipt provenance/allowed roots or an explicit approved new-scope registration manifest; reject closed namespaces and pin expected raw SHA so registered originals cannot silently change.

issues.finding: Exact-once enforcement only detects equal raw hashes/different CPU fields. An aggregate raw file and a separate included child/component raw file have different hashes and can both be charged despite the declared aggregate/child nonduplication scope.
issues.fix: Explicit covered-raw/alias or charge-group lineage must reject intersecting measured scopes across distinct registered raws; same-hash field dedup alone is insufficient.

otherwise_consistent: Known measured CPU, null administrative CPU and separately disclosed allowances stay distinct; totals cumulativeCPU/forecast/remaining budget debit CPU_accounting including allowances, and actual server stage CPU cannot be replaced by allowance.
limits: Static review only; no test/parser execution/actual fee collection, project imports, data/NN/SSH/runtime or unlisted WIP. No scientific result or numeric output edited.

receipt.scope: new accounting module/collector plus budget delta static read only; no actual cost collection/runtime/data/NN/WIP
receipt.unmetered_tail: Final receipt/output/write/exit, tool/service/model reasoning tails excluded; partial tool CPU

receipt.scope: only new accounting fixtures and budget-allowance fixture static read; no parser collection/tests/source/WIP
receipt.unmetered_tail: Final receipt/output/write/exit, tool/service/model reasoning tails excluded; partial tool CPU

charge_once: Charge THIS accounting aggregate once only, not its2 components, Task4fix or prior review receipts.
unmetered_tail: Final JSON serialization/write/output/exit, shell/tool/service and all model reasoning unmetered; partial measured local tool/process CPU only, not total model CPU or cumulative closure.
